topic: Outer elbow pain from your mouse?
caption:
Outer elbow pain but you don't play tennis? 🖱️
'Tennis elbow' is common with desk work, parenting and DIY — anything with repeated gripping.

Gradual strengthening often helps tendons more than rest alone.
